SPDT contacts for Alarm 1, Alarm 2 and fault, 5 A 230 V AC
Certified for gas groups IIA, IIB, IIC as per IS/IEC 60079
Rain canopy, mounting stand, mounting bracket, weatherproof cap, flasher / buzzer

counter-pod-system.intro: A portable overhead anchor for areas where overhead obstructions — high-tension cables, EOT cranes and the like — prevent anchoring. A concrete-filled counterweight box keeps it stable; the mast rotates 360° and it can be installed for permanent or temporary use by one worker.
specValues: Forklift pockets and four lifting hooks
Retractable fall arrest block with full body safety harness
features: Overhead anchoring for work at height — an effective, economical fall arrest system
Single point anchor with RCC / PCC filled counterweight box
Telescopic mast adjustable using an overhead crane or forklift
360° rotatable mast
Forklift pockets plus four lifting hooks for portability
Superior durability and weather resistance
setup: Lift the counterweight box by its fork pockets or lifting hooks and move the system to the work area.
Position it parallel to the work area, making sure there are no obstructions on the ground.
Raise the telescopic mast with a forklift and fit the clevis lock pin to fix the mast.
Pull down the snap hook with the fall arrest block's tag line and attach it to the safety harness — the system is ready.
For rotational movement, the mast turns through 360°.

modular-counter-pod-system.intro: A trolley-mounted overhead anchor for areas with limited space or no overhead anchoring structure. Removable metal counterweight blocks with handles make it easy to move, and four heavy-duty jacks keep it steady.
specValues: Retractable fall arrest block with full body safety harness
features: Overhead anchoring for work at height — an effective, economical fall arrest system
Single point anchor with metal counterweight blocks with handles
360° rotatable mast, adjustable using an overhead crane or forklift
Cast iron core wheels with moulded PU for grip on uneven surfaces
Locking steer handle and three-wheel steering for easy moving
setup: Lift the telescopic mast with a forklift and fit the clevis lock pin (one-time process).
Lower the levelling jacks, then remove the steer handle lock pin.
Move the system into position at the work surface, refit the steering handle lock pin and raise the levelling jacks.
Pull down the snap hook with the fall arrest block's tag line and attach it to the safety harness — the system is ready.
For rotational movement, the mast turns through 360°.

truck-flex-system.intro: A portable fall protection system for truck loading, unloading and maintenance. It uses the vehicle's own weight for stability — no heavy counterweights — with a 360° rotating boom and an adjustable mast.
specValues: Uses the vehicle's weight for secure anchorage
Shock absorber reduces impact force on the user
Forklift / manual by inbuilt steer wheel
Retractable fall arrest block with full body safety harness
features: Quick and easy connection for safe height access
No counterweights needed — uses the vehicle's weight
Lightweight at 370 kg
Telescopic mast extends 4.3–6 m in 0.5 m steps to clear obstacles
360° rotating boom reduces free-fall distance and swing hazard
Shock absorber minimises forces during a fall
Modular and portable — move with a forklift or the inbuilt steer wheel
setup: Position the system parallel to the work area with no obstructions on the ground, and drive the truck's rear wheel onto the pocket of the ramp.
Raise the telescopic mast to the required height with a forklift and fit the clevis lock pin.
Pull down the snap hook with the fall arrest block's tag line and attach it to the safety harness — the system is ready.
For rotational movement, the mast turns through 360°.
applications: Truck loading, unloading and maintenance where no overhead structure exists
Replaces costly fixed overhead anchor systems
limitations: Wheel diameter under 1.8 m (6 ft), width under 0.91 m (36 in)
Truck ground clearance over 115 mm (4.5 in)

porta-flex-system.intro: A wheeled overhead rail system for two workers, for areas where overhead obstructions prevent anchoring. Steering with steer locks on all four sides means it can be moved without turning the whole structure.
specValues: 7" diameter, industrial-grade metal core with moulded PU
Steering with steer lock on all four sides
SS 316 rail trolley with spring-loaded stopper
Retractable fall arrest block with full body safety harness
features: Overhead anchoring for work at height — an effective, economical fall arrest system
Rigid rail reduces fall clearance requirements
Cast iron core wheels with moulded PU for grip on uneven surfaces
Locking steer mechanism on all four sides for easy moving
Superior durability and weather resistance
setup: Remove the steer and handle lock pins on both front steering systems; leave the rear steering lock pins in place.
Move the system with both steerings in sync, position it at the work location and refit all lock pins.
Pull down the snap hook with the fall arrest block's tag line and attach it to the safety harness — the system is ready.
For horizontal movement, the channel trolley runs along the rail.
To move backwards, remove the rear steering lock pins, keep the front ones in place and move to the new location.

gantry-flex-system.intro: A mobile gantry for two workers with a height-adjustable, extendable access platform and telescopic ladder, for areas with insufficient overhead anchoring structures. Automobile-type steering and solid rubber wheels let it move over uneven ground.
specValues: 16", fabricated steel rim with moulded solid rubber
Retractable fall arrest block with full body safety harness
features: Overhead anchoring for work at height — an effective, economical fall arrest system
Height-adjustable, extendable platform with telescopic ladder for easy access
Self-locking manual worm winch for platform height adjustment
Solid rubber wheels for grip on uneven surfaces
Built-in automobile-type steering for easy turning and stable towers
Superior durability and weather resistance
Complies with OSHA 1926.502 and OSHA 1910.66
setup: Remove the steering handle lock pin, move the system to the work location and refit the lock pin.
Adjust the platform height with the winch, climb the telescopic ladder and extend the platform as needed.
Pull down the snap hook with the fall arrest block's tag line and attach it to the safety harness — the system is ready.
For horizontal movement, the channel trolley runs along the rail.

counterweight-c-frame-system.intro: A C-frame gantry on a mobile counterweight cart that creates an overhead anchor point for two workers, positioned close to the work surface without blocking the equipment being worked on.
specValues: One rail with two trolleys and tag line assist
features: Easily creates an overhead anchor point for two workers
Mobile counterweight blocks cart
Levelling jacks included
Positions close to the work surface without obstructing the equipment

philips-heartstart-frx.intro: A rugged, lightweight AED with step-by-step voice instructions, CPR guidance and an audible metronome. Pre-connected SMART Pads II work for adults and children, and it is built to handle rough use, dust, water and extreme temperatures.
specValues: SMART truncated exponential biphasic, adjusted to each patient's impedance
32 A peak current (150 J nominal) into a 50 ohm load
19 A peak current (50 J nominal) with the optional infant/child key
Delivers a shock typically within 8 seconds after CPR
Pre-connected SMART Pads II, adult and child
1.5 kg with battery and pads case; 1.2 kg without
Withstands 500 kg crush and 1.2 m drops
features: Step-by-step voice instructions with CPR guidance and metronome
Quick Shock: typically shocks within 8 seconds after CPR
SMART Pads II for adults and children — no pad change needed
Infant/child key adjusts instructions and energy
Rugged: water-jet proof, dust protected, survives drops and crush
Daily, weekly and monthly automatic self-tests
setup: Press the green On/Off button to start voice instructions.
Place the pads on the patient's bare chest as shown on the pads.
When the AED advises, press the orange Shock button, then follow the CPR guidance.

philips-heartstart-hs1.intro: An easy-to-use AED designed for ordinary people in an extraordinary moment. It coaches the responder with clear, step-by-step voice commands and real-time CPR guidance, and arrives ready to use with battery and pads pre-installed.
specValues: SMART truncated exponential biphasic, adjusted to patient impedance
32 A peak current (150 J nominal) into a 50 ohm load
19 A peak current (50 J nominal) with the optional infant/child SMART Pads cartridge
Delivers a shock typically within 8 seconds after CPR
9 V DC, 4.2 Ah lithium; minimum 200 shocks or 4 hours operating time; 4 years typical standby
SMART Pads cartridge, 85 cm² each; adult cable 137 cm
Green pads handle, green On/Off, blue i-button, orange Shock button
Defibrillator, battery and pads pre-installed, set-up guide, owner's manual, quick reference guide
features: Ready-Pack: battery and pads come pre-installed
Voice commands adapt to the responder's pace
Real-time CPR coaching with metronome
Infant/child pads cartridge automatically adjusts energy and instructions
Automatic daily, weekly and monthly self-tests
Quick Shock: typically shocks within 8 seconds after CPR
setup: Pull the green tab to start, then press the green On/Off button.
Place the pads on the patient as shown — the AED follows your pace.
Press the orange Shock button when advised and continue CPR as guided.

name.title: Harmony, together.
name.p1: “Alan Global Safety” means “harmony of peaceful existence together in the world”. It is a name meant to reach our customers’ hearts and build a safer, better working environment.
name.p2: Our logo shows two open hands holding a drop of water with the globe inside — protecting people, their workplaces and the world they live in.

about.statement: For {{years}}+ years we have played a pivotal role in industrial productivity and risk prevention — supplying the right equipment and training the people who use it.

training.title: Training
training.text: In-house and centralised programmes in fire safety, first aid, rescue and more.

divisions.text: Our safety equipment shapes a productive, intuitively safe culture from the root level. Providing comprehensive, standard safety equipment from head to toe is our priority — our way of helping secure a bright future for employees and their families.

ceo.alt: {{name}}, Chief Executive Officer of Alan Global Safety
ceo.p1: Our training evolution builds an ambitious environment and reaches the goal in a practical way. Joining hands with you is a privilege — together we can bring contentment to work in every corner of the site.
ceo.p2: In this drive we commit to on-time supply and dependable service, with continuous improvement at all times.
ceo.p3: Reinforcing cognitive safety solutions is our prime objective — it drives our ingenuity.
